title: The Jewel of Friendship
moral: True treasure is friendship and kindness.

scenes.summary: Sir Cedric hears about a magical jewel and begins his quest.
scenes.text: Sir Cedric, a brave and kind knight, heard from his friend Toby about a magical jewel hidden in the Enchanted Forest. With excitement, he decided to go on an adventure with Toby and Lady Eleanor.
scenes.image_prompt: knight and squire talking about treasure in castle courtyard colorful cartoon style
scenes.story: Sir Cedric was a brave and kind knight who lived in a beautiful land. One day, his friend Toby told him about a magical jewel hidden in the Enchanted Forest and guarded by a dragon. Sir Cedric, Toby, and Lady Eleanor set out on their journey. In the forest, they met the dragon, who challenged them with a riddle. Sir Cedric solved the riddle, and the dragon allowed them to see the jewel. The dragon explained that the jewel represented friendship and kindness. The group returned home happily, understanding that true treasure is not gold but friendship.

scenes.text: As they entered the Enchanted Forest, they heard a loud roar and saw a giant dragon guarding the treasure. The dragon questioned their intentions.
